notes.title: Version 1.5.0 Speedrun Mode
notes.content:
Speedrun Game Mode with stopwatch included and you can save your best run!
 We understand that some powerups were confusing so we switched the order for the transformation rate power up, now its easier to figure it out what it does.
 Some minor bugfixes

notes.title: Version 1.4 UI & Tutorial Rework
notes.content:
UI overhaul, now its easier to understand when gobby is about to transform!
 We received a lot of feedback about the tutorial level. Now it should be more acessible and better to learn the core mechanics
 minor bugfixes

notes.title: Version 1.3 Multi language added
notes.content:
More language support added: 

English
Spanish
Italian
Portuguese
French
German
Japanese
Chinese
Russian


And minor bugfixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2
notes.content:
Patch Notes 1.2

Features

  Added Steam Achievements support
 Overhauled the transformation UI, We saw some player getting confused about when they are going to shapeshift. if we keep seeing the same issue we will try to keep upgrading the UI until it's easy to understand.


Fixes

 Fixed some text colors in the intro cutscenes.
 Fixed a bug that caused the boss music to keep playing while starting a new level.
 Fixed hearts UI bug.
 Fixed a bug that the player could exit the limits of the loot room.
 Fixed a bug in the tutorial level where the players get stuck between doors.

notes.title: Version 1.1 is Out
notes.content:
